description: Minutes: keeping two devices in step. Every record carries `updatedAt` (milliseconds, strictly increasing per device). A device remembers for each record the `updatedAt` it last synced (`base`) and whether it has unsent edits (`dirty`). When it pulls (`pull`) or is about to write (`beforeWrite`) it compares its copy with the server's. Nothing is ever overwritten silently: when both sides changed since `base`, the record is held for a person to choose. Outcomes: `adopt` take the server copy; `keep` keep the local copy as is; `queue` keep it and send it; `conflict` hold both copies; `clear` the copies are identical, so nothing is left to send; `queue-new` a record the server does not have is sent.

pull.name: a record this device has never seen
no unsent edits, the server copy is newer
no unsent edits, the server copy is the same
no unsent edits, the server copy is older
unsent edits, and the server has not moved since the last sync
unsent edits, and the server copy changed since the last sync: held
unsent edits that turn out identical to the server copy
unsent edits and no record of a last sync: the newer copy wins
a record only this device has

beforeWrite.name: the server copy is the one this device last synced
someone else saved since the last sync
no record of a last sync, and this copy is newer
no record of a last sync, and this copy is older

resolve.name: use theirs: their copy replaces mine and nothing is left to send
keep mine: my copy becomes the newest and is sent
